Hello trace team,

We are asking you to review open dispute TR-006 for VEL-006-26, carrier reference VR-40681, due at 14 Laurel Row, Reedmere on 2026-10-14. The customer reports she was at home and received nothing.

Under procedure T6, the record supplied by the notification service at 08:20 (BST, +01:00) does not match this shipment:
- Notification app (captured 2026-10-14 08:00 +01:00): VR-40681, service date 2026-10-14, status delivered.
- Delivery record POD-40618 (exported 2026-10-14 08:00 +01:00): carrier reference VR-40618, service date 2026-10-13, handover 15:05 +01:00, different destination address, receiver mark SI.
The carrier reference, service date and address all differ. We are not drawing any conclusion from these differences.

Please:
1. Confirm whether a handover scan or proof of delivery exists for VR-40681 on 2026-10-14.
2. Give the last physical scan / current location of VR-40681.
3. Check why POD-40618 was attached to this notification.
4. Tell us your review timeline or finding for TR-006.

Please reply today (2026-10-14) if you can. Both files are attached.

This is a request for review, not a confirmation of any outcome.

Rivet Delivery Desk
